entries.title: Psalms 135:4
segments: God's church is peculiarly dear to him, because it is in her that he displays his glory, and through her that he overthrows the kingdom of Satan.

entries.title: Psalms 135:7
segments: Since God is the author of nature, all the powers of nature are under his control, and through them he does whatsoever he pleases.

entries.title: Psalms 135:11
segments: The Amorites--Bashan; these kingdoms lay on the east of the Jordan, and are therefore not reckoned to Canaan.

entries.title: Psalms 135:12
segments: The destruction of God's enemies always tends to the enlargement and comfort of his people.

entries.title: Psalms 135:13
segments: Thy memorial; the remembrance of thee; thy mighty deeds will always be remembered and mentioned with praise and thanksgiving.

entries.title: Psalms 135:18
segments: The folly of idolaters consists in their trusting for salvation to the work of their own hands.  All who rely on their riches, wisdom, or alliances with the great and powerful, are guilty of the same folly with idolaters, and will come to the same end.

entries.title: Psalms 135:19
segments: A heart full of praise and thanksgiving towards God is most excellent and becoming in all his servants.
